description: Plane-geometry helpers that use conventional short names (x, y, dx, dy, cos, sin, loop counter i, single-use lambda p) and a named degrees constant: none is a naming defect

hard.note: Short and single-letter identifiers look like unclear names, but each is a mathematical or loop convention the Naming Offender Catalog's What NOT to flag list exempts

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to nm-clear-names; zero findings once the catalog's loop-counter and single-use-lambda exemptions are applied
